comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"b7aca6e0b6da8cfb1244170aa6849474d99532d933a180e0bda2473c6268e954"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The report is unblocked AfterSell tracker requests (start.aftersell.app/api/public/metrics/log and /api/v1/visibilityEvents) on tommyjohn.com at checkout; the store's AfterSell app embed is loaded, but neither the tracker requests nor the candidate rule could be observed live because the add-to-bag control was refused as a purchase action and both apply_rule phase browsers got a 403 main-document response. The candidate rule ||start.aftersell.app^ (SpywareFilter/sections/tracking_servers.txt) is carried unverified for human review.

## Candidate for review

`||start.aftersell.app^`

SpywareFilter/sections/tracking_servers.txt

Not verified: apply_rule never judged the candidate:⁠ phase A navigation failed (http_blocked) with "main document returned HTTP 403" and the retry failed in phase B with the same HTTP 403, so no phase was captured and the run was told not to retry. The reported requests were also never observed live:⁠ the filtered session's inventory (artifact:⁠har:⁠8e74b4f1-3440-4785-98ad-99e5571396cb) holds no start.aftersell.app request, only the vendor embed cdn.shopify.com/extensions/01a18ee2.../aftersell-utm-triggers.js, because the add-to-bag step could not be rehearsed — the click on #⁠ProductForm-Add was refused with reason "purchase". CLI-route full-page vision reports reporterSymptomPresence indeterminate with no visible instance, as expected for a network-only symptom. Needs a checkout-flow re-test.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/41258019913

<sub>Automated analysis against filters at `c7d3b3c`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.</sub>
